parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` reflects the natural parallel shape of distinct test scenarios exercising the same system-under-test, not accidental duplication. Collapsing these into a generic helper would obscure the intent of each individual test case and couple unrelated assertions. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where any participating record has `is_test: true` warrants no-action.
